title: Cave Point E-Bike Ride + Island Fever Dinner
why: Fall visitors who want an easy afternoon: short e-bike ride to Cave Point, then dinner a minute from the shop. Shareable with Island Fever.
hook_options: Ride to Cave Point. Eat down the road.
Earn your dinner on an e-bike.
Cliffs by day, rum bar by dinner.
caption: Easy fall afternoon: grab a fat tire e-bike at our Jacksonport shop, ride about 4.5 miles to Cave Point, then roll back to @islandfeverjport for dinner, one minute from our shop. Two hours is plenty. Photos courtesy of Island Fever. Save this for your trip and send it to your dinner date. #DoorCounty #Jacksonport #CavePoint #EBikeRental #DoorCountyFall

slides.kicker: With Island Fever Rum Bar & Grill
slides.headline: Ride Cave Point. Dinner at Island Fever.
slides.body: Island Fever Rum Bar & Grill is one minute from our Jacksonport shop.

slides.headline: Rent the bike.
slides.body: Fat tire e-bikes, ready at our Jacksonport shop. Book online at doorcountykayaktours.com.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-point-county-park-electric-bike-rental-2.jpg

slides.headline: Start on Hwy 57.
slides.body: Fat tire e-bikes are $30 an hour or $60 for two. Two hours covers the ride and a good look around.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Ice castles ebike tour photos/Door-County-ebike-garage.jpg

slides.headline: Ride to Cave Point.
slides.body: About 4.5 miles from the shop. Cliffs, clear water and picnic tables if you want a stop.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Ice castles ebike tour photos/curvy-road-cave-point-ebike-tour.jpg

slides.headline: Mind the edge.
slides.body: Rocks are slippery when wet, and the water is shallow. No jumping.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-Bike-Rental-Jac.jpg

slides.headline: Ride back. You've earned it.
slides.body: Return the bike to the shop, then dinner is one minute away.

slides.headline: Island Fever Rum Bar & Grill.
slides.body: Seafood, hand-cut steaks and burgers from Jacksonport grass-fed cattle, plus American and Mexican dishes.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Island Fever (permission OK 2026-10-26)/island-fever-family-outdoor-dining.jpg

slides.headline: Fire pit out back.
slides.body: Warm up after the ride with a drink by the fire. Island Fever has a rum bar and a fire pit.
